name: Rhode Island
agencyName: Rhode Island Division of Motor Vehicles

retake.retakeFee: Retest fee applies; see DMV permit fee table

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 50 hours (10 at night), certified by affidavit
gdl.nightCurfew: Unsupervised driving only 5 a.m.-1 a.m. for the first 12 months (with work/school/EMS exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 12 months: no more than 1 passenger under 21 (excluding immediate family/household members)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or unexpired passport)
Proof of Social Security Number (or SSA ineligibility letter)
Two documents proving Rhode Island residency
Under 18: driver education completion certificate and parent/guardian signature (or notarized form)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID-compliant license/permit requires proof of identity and date of birth, proof of Social Security Number, and two proofs of Rhode Island residency, plus documentation of any legal name change.
process.permitFee: $13.50 limited instruction permit (under 18); $8.50 adult instruction permit
process.licenseFee: $29.50 limited provisional license; $44.50 first license (age 18+) plus $28.50 road test fee
process.visionStandard: Vision screening administered at the DMV (current acuity standard not confirmed on an official page)

facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if unable to change lanes safely, for stopped emergency, maintenance, and tow vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 65 mph on rural interstates (55 mph on urban interstates)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph in a marked school zone during posted school hours when children are present

references.label: Graduated licensing law table
references.citation: IIHS Graduated Licensing Laws Table (Rhode Island)

verifyNote: Official RI DMV pages confirm the 25-question exam with 20 correct required, current permit/license fees, minimum ages, and GDL requirements. Rhode Island does not use a demerit-point system. The numeric vision acuity standard remains unconfirmed, so the field states only that screening is administered.
